$comment: The retry policy's parity table. The dashboard (ui/packages/app/lib/api/retry.ts) and the CLI (cli/src/lib/http-retry.ts) each replay every case through their own transport and must make the same number of attempts. A script entry is either an answer, `{ "status": N }` with an optional `retryAfterSeconds`, or a failure before an answer, `{ "error": CODE }` where CODE is a socket code Node's fetch puts on the error's cause, or `timeout` for the transport's own clock running out. Attempts beyond the script repeat its last entry. `preSendCodes` is the set of cause codes that prove a request never left; both classifiers assert their own set equals it. Both cap a `Retry-After` at `policy.retryAfterCapSeconds` and fail at once beyond it.

cases.name: a read recovers from a blip
the ceiling holds against a backend that stays down
a read obeys a rate limit
a read that timed out on the client is read again
a read reset after sending is read again
the replay-safe write is sent again after a gateway error
a write is not sent again after a gateway error
a write obeys a rate limit: the server did not run it
a write declined as a server timeout is sent again
a write that timed out on the client is sent once
a write refused at connect never left and is sent again
a write reset after sending is sent once
a write whose name did not resolve is sent again
a Retry-After beyond the cap fails at once, with the 429 in hand
